text:
Tara (Growth): Quick triage 18: publishing webinar landing + three launch posts. Need a final SEO checklist: keyword mapping, JSON-LD (Event + FAQ where useful), internal anchor map, and cleanup redirects for /events and /webinars. Lock content by EOD.
Ben (SEO): I'll own keywords + anchor text. Plan: 2 primary + 1 longtail per page, mark SERP intent, and add 3 anchor variants per internal link.
Maya (Content): Drafts uploaded. Adding 160-char metas and OG images (1200x630). Will mark slugs and indicate which old pages are duplicates.
Ike (Web): For SSR pages inject JSON-LD into head; for SPA routes prerender. Example event JSON-LD: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Serving LLMs at Scale","startDate":"2026-11-10T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-llms"} (paste in head).
seo-bot: Preflight: unique title tags, unique meta descriptions, single H1, JSON-LD present where applicable, internal links use descriptive anchors, redirects are 301 with no chains.
Tara (Growth): Redirect plan: whitelist known old slugs and 301 to new landing preserving querystrings/UTMs. Evergreen posts keep their own canonical; only duplicate splash pages get redirected.
Ben (SEO): Internal link plan (summary): landing -> /product/inference (anchors: "LLM inference platform", "high-throughput inference", "reduce token cost"); benchmark -> /benchmarks ("inference benchmarks", "latency & cost charts"); recap -> /resources/webinars ("watch on-demand", "webinar recording"). Will add these to the sheet with primary targets.
Maya (Content): I'll add FAQ pairs to the recap post (short Q/A) for FAQ schema. Also ensuring meta uniqueness between landing & post1.
Ike (Web): I'll implement nginx 301s preserving querystring: `return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/serve-llms?$query_string;` and run a dry-run in staging. Will queue CDN invalidation for OG after deploy and add sitemap entries (priority 0.8, lastmod=publish).
Tara (Growth): Owners/deadlines: Maya - final copy + metas + slug decisions by 4pm PT; Ben - keywords + anchor variants by 4pm; Ike - redirects + JSON-LD placement tomorrow AM; seo-bot - final scan after staging deploy. Ping me for blockers. Thanks!
